propositions: Structured-output validation and recovery must execute through a single Pydantic Agent operation with a shared approved request budget across all retry, fallback, and instrumentation concerns.
Retry context must preserve complete failed responses on proven fit, otherwise omit them wholly, and never truncate authoritative input, accepted output, or stored history.

Rebar deterministic extraction, fallback eligibility, terminal refusal/filter behavior, typed exhaustion, final-failure artifacts, and answering-model provenance must be preserved through the Pydantic integration.
Usage reporting must emit complete Pydantic run metrics exactly once per successful operation, while fallback/downgrade candidates remain as trace or journal events without competing usage counters.

The legacy bespoke structured-output retry loop removal is gated on compatibility suite and authorized provider cache-canary evidence passing, with code completion deferred pending provider credentials.
